brainlife.desc: ABCD-HCP (DCAN) pipeline output folder per subject/session: executive summary, MNINonLinear results, T1w and task folders.
brainlife.name: neuro/hcp/abcd-fmri

original.desc: Output folder containing files like in https://github.com/DCAN-Labs/abcd-hcp-pipeline?ref=https://githubhelp.com#outputs
original.readme:
The outputs are organized in the following structure:
```
output_dir/
|__ sub-id
    |__ ses-session
        |__ files
        |   |__ executive_summary
        |   |__ MNINonLinear
        |   |   |__ fsaverage_LR32k
        |   |   |__ Results
        |   |__ T1w
        |   |   |__ id
        |   |__ task-taskname
        |__ logs
```

The outputs are organized in the following structure:

|__ sub-id

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.hcp.abcd-fmri.json

identifying_risks: Includes whole-head T1w/T2w images with recognisable faces
Logs may hold paths, dates and IDs
sharing_cautions: Deface before sharing outside a controlled project
tier_conditions: Tier 2 once whole-head anatomical images are defaced or removed
